# Asm

> Asm is a package registry and command-line tool for assembly projects.

Use explicit targets, inspect exact releases, and retain evidence for the resulting software.
These entry points become available when this site build is published.

## Agent entry points

- [Start an assembly task](https://asm.build/agents.md): Requirements, targets, reuse, development, and evidence limits.
- [Asm development skill](https://asm.build/skills/asm-build/SKILL.md): The maintained workflow and focused references.
- [Package catalog](https://asm.build/registry/v1/index.json): Current package records, versions, artifacts, and evidence.

## Integration and service status

- [MCP setup](https://github.com/stubbi/asm/blob/main/docs/agents.md): Source-checkout setup, read-only tools, and hosted configuration.
- [Hosted registry contract](https://github.com/stubbi/asm/blob/main/docs/hosted-registry.md): Service scope, activation gates, and remaining recovery checks.
- [Source and current status](https://github.com/stubbi/asm): Supported hosts, prerequisites, and release limits.

These static files do not run hosted builds or a remote MCP endpoint.
The prepared hosted registry and MCP deployment remain under qualification.
